metadata.name: a230-desktop-compact-duration
metadata.description: Require the reference work title to remain hidden and its compact duration to remain visible without overflow on a desktop Today viewport; capture the rendered desktop state without business writes.

metadata.label: Open Today under the routed reference-scale lease
Wait for the seeded reference work timeline block

evaluate.expression: (() => { const visible=e=>{if(!e?.isConnected)return false;const s=getComputedStyle(e),r=e.getBoundingClientRect();return s.display!=='none'&&s.visibility!=='hidden'&&Number(s.opacity)!==0&&r.width>0&&r.height>0&&r.bottom>0&&r.top<innerHeight&&r.right>0&&r.left<innerWidth}; const block=[...document.querySelectorAll('.day-plan .time-block.compact')].find(e=>e.dataset.fullTitle?.startsWith('P1 Reference work ')&&visible(e)); if(!block) throw new Error('Reference work compact block is not visible on desktop'); const title=block.querySelector('.time-block-title'),duration=block.querySelector('.time-block-duration'); if(!title||!new RegExp('^P1 Reference work [0-9]{4}$').test(title.textContent.trim())) throw new Error('Desktop compact title content is unavailable'); if(visible(title)) throw new Error('Desktop compact title should stay hidden'); if(!duration||!visible(duration)||!new RegExp('^[0-9]+m$').test(duration.textContent.trim())) throw new Error('Desktop compact duration is not visibly rendered'); const dr=duration.getBoundingClientRect(),br=block.getBoundingClientRect(); if(dr.left<br.left-1||dr.right>br.right+1) throw new Error('Desktop compact duration extends beyond its block bounds'); return {viewport:{width:innerWidth,height:innerHeight},title:title.textContent.trim(),title_visible:false,duration:duration.textContent.trim(),duration_visible:true,duration_rect:(()=>{const r=duration.getBoundingClientRect();return {left:r.left,right:r.right}})(),block_rect:(()=>{const r=block.getBoundingClientRect();return {x:r.x,y:r.y,width:r.width,height:r.height}})()}; })()
